description: Implement the JmapMailExt extension trait over jmap-base-client. Adds typed methods for Email/get, Email/set, Email/query, Email/changes, Email/copy, Mailbox/get, Mailbox/set, Mailbox/changes, Mailbox/query, Thread/get, Thread/changes, Identity/get, Identity/set, Identity/changes, EmailSubmission/set, SearchSnippet/get, VacationResponse/get, VacationResponse/set. Each method builds a JmapRequest, calls the base client, and deserializes the typed response. Spec: RFC 8621. Pattern: follow jmap-chat-client exactly (session.rs, per-method modules, JmapMailExt trait, wiremock integration tests).
title: jmap-mail-client: RFC 8621 client methods
